verdict.rationale: BVNK documents creating crypto and fiat wallets for your own business account via Portal or API, and references holding and using stablecoin balances (sending stablecoins, linking cards, rewards on idle balances). Coverage of where it's available is only a generic "130+ countries" claim. Nothing in the evidence describes custody terms, per-geography or per-asset availability, or onboarding and eligibility gating. Missing for 10: explicit custodial account documentation, per-region or per-stablecoin availability, honest statement of eligibility or KYB gating, independent hands-on corroboration.
